newsitem.title: POLAND: Commmerzbank to lend BWR PLN 10 mln.
newsitem.headline: Commmerzbank to lend BWR PLN 10 mln.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG will lend Poland's Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej (BWR) 10 million zlotys, BWR said in a statement on Friday.
The statement said the eight-year low interest loan would be exchangeable for convertible bonds.
Earlier this week LG Investment Holding BV, a subsidiary of South Korea's LG Group, lent BWR 10 million zlotys with the possibility of exchanging the loan into the bank's common shares.
BWR said last month it planned a new share issue for a strategic investor but would not give details.
